title: Build a Visual Authoring Layer for Agent-Edited Game Geometry
summary: Matias Villagrán explains how repeated Swift edits, builds, and screenshots made small geometry changes in a native SwiftUI and Metal game take hours and heavy token use. He and Codex instead built a visual authoring layer over the real runtime assets that validates routes, widths, gates, enemies, and checkpoints, then exports structured JSON the agent can consume directly.
takeaway: When agents repeatedly reconstruct spatial state from code and screenshots, expose the real runtime model in a visual editor and export validated structured data as the new source of truth.
